_about: Budgets for the performance run (e2e/perf.spec.mjs, checked by e2e/perf-report.mjs). A run whose number is above its budget is listed; with enforce true the job fails. Measured on GitHub's runners in software WebGL, so these are not phone or GPU figures: see docs/PERFORMANCE.md. Pages override the defaults per profile. Times in ms, sizes in MB.
_pages: Page overrides are for what a page must load (Cesium alone is 5.9 MB, the Solar System's data 4 MB), set just above the 2026-10-31 baseline; the frame and long-task budgets stay at their goals and warn until the polish lands.
